name.zh: PostHog 运行时采集与功能开关 API
name.en: PostHog Runtime Capture and Flag Evaluation API

boundary.zh: 官方文档定义的完整公开项目令牌运行时 API：POST /i/v0/e/、POST /batch/ 与 POST /flags?v=2。排除个人 API key 管理面、/flags/definitions 本地求值、SSE/workflow API、静态资源以及已弃用的 /capture、/engage、/decide。
boundary.en: The complete documented public project-token runtime API: POST /i/v0/e/, POST /batch/, and POST /flags?v=2. It excludes the personal-API-key management surface, /flags/definitions local evaluation, SSE/workflow APIs, static assets, and deprecated /capture, /engage, and /decide routes.

blockers.zh: 独立 SDK 与 CLI 尚未生成、测试、发布到 npm 并以干净安装验证；完成后才可将候选提升到目录。
blockers.en: The independent SDK and CLI have not yet been generated, tested, published to npm, and verified from a clean install; the candidate cannot be admitted until then.

blockers.zh: 网站尚未部署该产品；完成 SDK registry 证据后，仍需提升 metadata、部署 Hub，并在生产环境验证中文/英文目录、Endpoint、Schema、SDK 和 CLI 流程。
blockers.en: The website does not yet deploy this product. After registry evidence exists, metadata must be promoted, Hub deployed, and the Chinese/English catalog, Endpoint, Schema, SDK, and CLI flows verified in production.

nextAction.zh: 以 candidates/posthog/contract 中固定文档 revision 的 3 个 Endpoint、8 个 Schema 生成独立 TypeScript SDK 与 CLI；运行单元/集成测试、npm 发布和干净安装验证。随后将同一契约提升到 products/posthog，更新目录与 SDK registry 证据，部署 Hub，并在生产站点验证双语文档、SDK/CLI 与搜索路径。
nextAction.en: Generate an independent TypeScript SDK and CLI from the three Endpoints and eight Schemas at the fixed documentation revision in candidates/posthog/contract; run unit/integration tests, npm publication, and clean-install verification. Then promote the same contract into products/posthog, update the catalog and SDK registry evidence, deploy Hub, and verify bilingual docs, SDK/CLI, and search paths in production.
